sourceRequest: Slack DM과 research-center 스레드에서 직원 답변이 돌아오지 않는 문제 조사
outcome: Trace the named Slack messages through ingress, PostgreSQL, Temporal and the pinned worker; prepare a scoped repair that restores visible replies while preserving research execution and delivery receipts.

deliverables.description: Real Slack and production readback for both linked threads
Durable progress responses and an owner-visible project-limit notice
One-line outbound-role compatibility repair against the exact pinned research worker source
Real PostgreSQL regression tests, lint, and explicit simulated-versus-live evidence
Review current release and in-flight effects, then apply and verify only the approved production change

constraints: Preserve the active research mission, old worker pin, stable turn IDs and ambiguous-effect receipts
Do not replay rejected Slack events or uncertain model/Slack effects automatically
No credentials, user message bodies or research performance figures in incident evidence
Company evidence stays in this repository; research integrations remain read-only
workspace: Existing isolated qws attachment; the historical Quant contract is unchanged.
approval: Read-only diagnosis and local repair preparation are complete. Production cutover requires review under the autonomous-research runbook.
